title: A different perspective on Barcelona's architecture, including Gaudi and beyond
text:
Michael was our very professional and respectful guide. 

We started in front of La Pedrera. There, and at every building we visited, he told us very interesting stories, both architectural and historical, with colorful commentary illustrating the anecdotes behind each building, popular streets, and even lampposts. 

It was a very unique tour to meet Barcelona's most famous architects, beyond the master Gaudí. 

The two hours flew by without us even noticing, despite the heat. 

He was a pleasure to work with.

title: Excellent Walking Tour
text: This was a wonderful walking tour! Christian had many interesting stories, insights, and tidbits about the architecture and architects as well the culture of Barcelona. He kept a great pace, and our family (including two teens) found it very interesting and a great use of time in the city.
author: Ryan_H

title: Great private walking tour
text:
Excellent walking tour with Michael as our guide. We were able to learn more about the history of Barcelona, Gaudí and other architects that designed interesting buildings. 
Michael kept us involved in the tour by asking us questions about what we saw in buildings. Our tour was casual, like walking with a friend.
Definitely would recommend.
author: Shannon_C

title: Recommended in Barcelona
text: Highly recommended. Time is taken to dwell on buildings so that you really understand what has been built. Very nice host who knows a lot about things. Next time in Barcelona we will go back for the chocolate tour.

title: A great Barcelona experience
text: We had an amazing experience walking around Barcelona admiring the beautiful architecture of Barcelona, the rich history of Barcelona and learning about the stories of the architects and how they created these masterpieces. We were fortunate enough to be the only people on tour that day with Michael, so we could completely tailor the tour to fit our needs. We got some great insights and stories of that time. This tour helped enrich our overall Barcelona experience I’d surely be recommending them to anyone
